hints: Notice that two different chemical tests are given, so think about what type of alcohol each test identifies.
Decolourising warm acidified manganate(VII) means the alcohol can be oxidised, so it must be primary or secondary, not tertiary.
A yellow precipitate with alkaline iodine is the iodoform test, so look for the alcohol that contains the $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)}-$ group.
walkthrough:
**Use the manganate(VII) test**

Warm acidified $\text{MnO}_4^-$ is a strong oxidising agent. It is decolourised by primary and secondary alcohols, but not by tertiary alcohols.

So our alcohol must be primary or secondary.

**Use the iodine test**

Alkaline aqueous iodine gives yellow $\text{CHI}_3$ precipitate only with a very specific group.

For an alcohol, the positive group is:
$$\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)}-$$

**Check the four structures**

Draw or picture the carbon with the -OH group.

Only 3-methylbutan-2-ol is $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)CH(CH}_3\text{)CH}_3$, a secondary alcohol containing $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)}-$. It passes both tests, so it fits perfectly.

options.A: 2-methylbutan-2-ol is $(\text{CH}_3)_2\text{C(OH)CH}_2\text{CH}_3$, a tertiary alcohol. It cannot be oxidised so it will not decolourise warm acidified $\text{MnO}_4^-$, and it lacks the $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)}-$ group so it gives no iodoform precipitate.
options.B: 3-methylbutan-2-ol is $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)CH(CH}_3\text{)CH}_3$. It is secondary so it is oxidised and decolourises $\text{MnO}_4^-$, and it contains $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)}-$ so it gives yellow $\text{CHI}_3$ with alkaline iodine. It satisfies both observations.
options.C: Pentan-1-ol is $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$, a primary alcohol. It will decolourise $\text{MnO}_4^-$, but it has $\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$ not $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)}-$, so it fails the iodoform test.
options.D: Pentan-3-ol is $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH(OH)CH}_2\text{CH}_3$, a secondary alcohol. It will decolourise $\text{MnO}_4^-$, but the group next to -OH is $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2-$, not $\text{CH}_3-$, so it does not contain $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)}-$ and gives no iodoform precipitate.
